note: The input-controlled configuration sets encoding=ucs-2, selecting the direct two-byte decoder for later speller word conversion.
The configured encoding is used to construct to_internal_, so encoded API words are converted through DecodeDirect<unsigned short>.
The UCS-2 document word is decoded for tokenization; this vulnerable decoder appends FilterChar values with width 1 instead of sizeof(Chr).
For the five-code-unit UCS-2 misspelling, tok.len is computed as a character count rather than the original ten-byte input span, producing the odd size 5.
aspell_speller_suggest converts data_str + token.offset using token.len, so the odd length reaches the UCS-2 conversion routine.
With Chr as unsigned short and size 5, stop is in the middle of a code unit; the loop steps by two bytes and reads past the end while trying to reach the misaligned stop pointer.
